learning: Track width at y 0.08 with kp 4.0 is monotone to 0.16 (661.5), with diminishing gains. The 0.17 step tests whether the trend flattens or reverses. Slalom has been 0/20 at every geometry, so it needs its own test after track width settles.
notes: Iteration 9 package: the Builder's wheel_track 0.17 geometry on the iteration 8 sensor layout, with the controller unchanged from iteration 8. Only track width differs from the 661.5 best.
rationale: The Builder's proposal sets wheel_track to 0.17 m with everything else at iteration 8 values (y 0.08, 16 mm footprints, x ±0.024 m span, body, wheels and mass unchanged). I integrate it without controller changes, so the race isolates track width. The track-width sweep at y 0.08 with kp 4.0 is monotone: 0.10 gave 496.4, 0.12 gave 561.6, 0.14 gave 628.6 and 0.16 gave 661.5. Its s-bend off-track exits fell 15, 9, 4, 1 of 20, and control_effort fell to 8.2. The step gains are shrinking, so 0.17 is expected to be a small gain at most. Oscillation has stayed low (oval 0.21, s-bend 0.29), so the controller has no sign of gain stress. kp stays at 4.0 because kp 4.5 was harmful when the span was widened (iteration 2), and no evidence shows that a track change needs a gain change. ki 0.1, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.6, last_direction and weights [2,1,0,-1,-2] are unchanged from the best-known controller. Slalom is 0 of 20 at every geometry tested with line_loss 1.05 to 1.35, and track width does not address it. Full measurements are requested so the next race can test the Builder's revert gates (s-bend exits, max_error, oval finish) and the slalom question.
